imputation: feature median for sporadic missing; no structurally missing dataset
signed_transform: Fisher z for r; column centered and SD scaled
ecology_axes: all Epi labelled R12 proportions; PC1 and PC2 fixed without outcomes
ecology_inference: unit-level HC3 with dataset fixed effects; conditional spatial-SE WLS sensitivity
combination_inference: equal dataset means; unit-level conditional Welch uncertainty and separate dataset-replicate t test if k>=3
missing_unit_policy: preserve section-only records for descriptive seven-dataset references; no invented biological unit IDs or inference for combinations containing them
